    [τB : TopologicalSpace B] (e : A ≃ₜ B) : τB = τA.coinduced e := by

    A : Type u_1
    B : Type u_2
    τA : TopologicalSpace A
    τB : TopologicalSpace B
    e : Homeomorph A B
    ⊢ Eq τB (TopologicalSpace.coinduced (⇑e) τA)
  -/

  /-
    case a.h.a
    A : Type u_1
    B : Type u_2
    τA : TopologicalSpace A
    τB : TopologicalSpace B
    e : Homeomorph A B
    U : Set B
    ⊢ Iff (IsOpen U) (IsOpen U)
  -/
  nth_rw 2 [isOpen_coinduced]
  /-
    case a.h.a
    A : Type u_1
    B : Type u_2
    τA : TopologicalSpace A
    τB : TopologicalSpace B
    e : Homeomorph A B
    U : Set B
    ⊢ Iff (IsOpen U) (IsOpen (Set.preimage (⇑e) U))
  -/
  exact e.isOpen_preimage.symm
  /-

  -/
